artifact_observations.location: Right side of the menu grid, specifically the bottom rows under 'Winter season' and notes.
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the main list is legible, the smaller text blocks on the right (notes/disclaimers) show signs of AI degradation. Characters are malformed, spacing is inconsistent, and some English words appear slightly nonsensical or fused, typical of AI struggling with dense small print.

The top horizontal line of the grid wavers slightly and does not maintain perfect straightness relative to the vertical lines, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation of the rigid object.
The reflection/glare is somewhat uniform but lacks the complex micro-scratches or dust usually seen on real laminated surfaces, appearing slightly 'plastic' or digitally smooth.
